model_name: Comprehensive ADAS & Autonomous Driving Hardware-Software System
description: The automotive industry is rapidly advancing towards autonomous driving and enhanced safety features, such as advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) with technologies like lane departure warnings, collision avoidance, and driver monitoring systems. The global push for safer vehicles, coupled with regulatory pressures and consumer expectations, is driving the adoption of sophisticated ADAS solutions.
system_benefits:
• The image recognition engine optimizes the performance-to-power balance, while the Quad Arm® Cortex®-A53 and Cortex®-R7 enable advanced video processing and image recognition, enhancing system detection and responsiveness to driving conditions and obstacles.
  • ISO 26262 compliant pre-regulator and PMIC for the R-Car V3H system-on-chip (SoC) enable high efficiency and reduced peripheral components for analyzing a car's surroundings and cognitive computing processing.
  • A programmable clock generator (1MHz to 500MHz) replaces several crystal oscillators with a single device, reducing the BOM, saving space, and cutting costs.
  • Supports the reduced gigabit media-independent interface (RGMII) (2 channels) as the Ethernet IF and CSI2 (2 channels) as the camera IF to accommodate various inputs and outputs.

model_name: Parking Assistance System with AHL Camera
description: This automotive parking assistance camera system uses Renesas’ Analog High-Definition Link (AHL) solution, which is a high-definition analog video transmission technology. By leveraging the lower transmission bandwidth of AHL, the OEM can use low-cost twisted pair cabling and traditional connectors. The AHL camera reference design has an OmniVision OX01F 1.3 megapixel (MP) SoC (Sensor + ISP) and Renesas camera PMIC, and features low power consumption in a small module size, making it ideal for automotive camera systems. The AHL signal is transmitted over unshielded twisted pair cables, received by the ECU, decoded, and converted to digital format, and then sent to the SoC for video analytics and parking assist graphical overlay. The final video is sent to a display module that utilizes aTW8846(orRAA278842) LCD controller to drive the LCD panel.
system_benefits:
• AHL is an HD analog video link solution for parking assistance camera systems.
  • Ideal for rear camera, surround view, and mirror replacement camera systems.
  • HD video transmission using low-cost SD analog video cables and connectors.
  • Lower cable and connector costs by ~30% for automotive camera systems compared to digital transmission.
  • No latency and no loss in picture quality or object recognition software accuracy.
  • Bidirectional I2C control channel – independent of the video.
  • SoC: Low power consumption hardware accelerators for object detection/classification algorithms.
  • Optimized power management ICs for the camera and ECU.

model_name: Video Output Expansion for Surround View & AR-HUD
description: For surround view and augmented reality heads-up display (AR HUD) applications, the combination of R-Car V3H and TW8846/8847 enables these two applications’ video outputs and AI processing in one system at the same time, reducing the system BOM cost.
system_benefits:
• Easily expandable from existing R-Car V3H systems
  • High-accuracy AI image recognition is possible by using R-Car V3H with CNN IP
  • R-Car V3H and PMIC support functional safety up to ISO 26262 ASIL B
  • Integrates many components in several Renesas R-Car systems into a tiny CMIC, allowing product differentiation at a lower cost and PCB space
  • Cost-effective HD camera system by using AHL’s low-cost connectors and cables
  • Reduced system complexity with analog video transmission with no loss of signal quality
  • Support for longer cable lengths suitable for video data transmission in commercial vehicles and buses

description: This open front camera solution features Renesas’ R-Car V3H System-on-Chip (SoC). This all-in-one scalable camera platform targets the latest Euro New Car Assessment Program (NCAP) and Chinese Car Safety Assessment Program (C-NCAP) requirements, such as automatic emergency braking, forward collision warning, lane keeping assist, and traffic sign recognition.
system_benefits:
• Turnkey end-to-end solution for NCAP on front camera application (ASIL B).
  • Optimized solution offers low BOM and reduces the customer’s R&D effort.
  • A variety of perception software is available from partners (Cartica, Phantom AI, and StradVision) which greatly reduces R&D turnaround time (TAT) and efforts.
  • Other possible extensions include surround view, driver monitoring, augmented reality video, and radar fusion to enhance supported driving functions.
  • Highest TOPS/Watt performance with deep learning engine for object detection, classification algorithms, and real-time AUTOSAR support.
  • PMIC optimized for R-Car V3x with higher efficiency and functional safety (FuSa) features.

model_name: Automotive Camera Solution with AHL Control Channel
description: The combination of Renesas MCU and automotive high-definition link (AHL) devices enables the use of only a twisted pair cable for video transmission and control camera systems such as rear camera, surround view and electronic door mirror.
system_benefits:
• The I2C signal that controls the blower motor can be superimposed on the video signal of the Renesas video transmission system AHL. Therefore, data transmission is possible only with the twisted pair cable, contributing to low cost and light weight.
  • Shorten development period and cost by using the AHL camera and evaluation board, which provide an environment for quick and easy development.

description: This solution provides a high-efficiency image recognition engine, functional safety (FuSa) features, and a high level of integration to implement solutions for various applications like front cameras, surround view, and light detection and ranging (LiDAR) systems in order to meet New Car Assessment Program (NCAP) evaluation criteria.
system_benefits:
• Enables advanced video processing and image recognition using the R-Car V3M system-on-chip (SoC) with an image recognition engine, optimized performance-to-power balance, and dual Arm® Cortex®-A53 and Cortex-R7.
  • A flexible power design can supply a wide range of multicore SoCs and integrates full power rail management with multiple sleep modes for an optimized system solution.
  • Reduces R&D cost and development time using PMICs verified for R-Car automotive SoCs.

model_name: Bi-directional DC/DC Converter for 12V/48V EV/HEV Systems
description: As electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) gain popularity, there's a growing demand for efficient energy management and dual-voltage systems to transfer energy between 12V and 48V power nets. Renesas bi-directional DC/DC converter is ideal for 48V mild hybrid electric vehicles and electric motorcycles, featuring a highly efficient 12V/48V DC/DC converter. The design consists of an LV1481board net and supports functional safety2.
system_benefits:
• Multi-phase DC/DC system delivers over 3kW between 12V and 48V board nets at over 95% efficiency.
  • Bi-directional analog controller eliminates the need for DSP with complicated firmware, separate buck/boost controllers, and complex switching logic, reducing development time, BOM, and costs.
  • Supports ASIL B automotive safety standard under ISO26262 with Renesas MCU and regulator.

model_name: Bi-directional GaN DC/DC Converter for 12V/48V EV/HEV Systems
description: As electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) gain popularity, there's a growing demand for efficient energy management and dual-voltage systems to transfer energy between 12V and 48V power nets. This design is ideal for 48V mild hybrid electric vehicles (MHEV) and electric motorcycles,featuringhighly efficient 12V/48V DC/DC converters. It reduces PCB area by 46% using Gallium Nitride (GaN) High-Electron-Mobility Transistors (HEMTs) with excellent switching characteristics, enabling high efficiency power conversion at a 500kHz switching frequency with small 1.3µH inductors.
system_benefits:
• Bi-directional analog controller eliminates the need for DSP with complicated firmware, separate buck/boost controllers, and complex switching logic, reducing development time, BOM, and costs.
  • Supports ASIL B automotive safety standard under ISO26262 with Renesas MCU and regulator.
  • Automatic phase drop function achieves over 94% power efficiency across a wide load range (400W to 3kW).
  • Adaptive dead time function automatically adjusts for optimal control.
  • MCU supports mode setting and status monitoring of DC/DC converters via CAN FD.

model_name: 3-in-1 Electric Vehicle Unit: 48V Inverter, Onboard Charger, DC/DC Converter
description: Electric vehicles (EVs) are transitioning from traditional distributed systems to a centralized architecture to reduce size, weight, and cost. This 3-in-1 system integrates a traction motor controller, onboard charger, and DC/DC conversion for auxiliary loads into a single unit. This integration streamlines vehicle assembly by reducing wiring harness complexity and part count. Within the 3-in-1 module, all functions are managed by a single MCU, further reducing system cost and complexity.
system_benefits:
• A powerful MCU controls multiple functions simultaneously, reducing BOM count and system complexity.
    • The internal Resolver/Digital Converter (RDC2) and motor control unit (EMU2) of the MCU reduce CPU load, efficiently controlling motors with minimal CPU involvement.
  • GaN-based PFC is highly efficient, reducing system size and power consumption.
  • Integrating multiple functions into a centralized unit reduces wiring harness complexity.

description: Electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE) refers to the infrastructure that supplies electric energy for recharging electric vehicles (EVs), including plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs). Modern EVSE systems provide essential hardware and integrate software to manage power delivery, monitor usage, and handle billing for commercial charging stations.
system_benefits:
• Supports flexible configurations for 1-phase to 3-phase charging systems for power up to 22kW.
  • MCU supports dual-flash bank operation, allowing safe over-the-air (OTA) updates and fallback.
  • High voltage AC/DC eliminates the need for optocouplers, simplifying the system architecture.

description: This solution offers a complete automotive battery management system for up to 70 series-connected Li-ion cells. The microcontroller (MCU) along with the multi-cell Li-ion battery management devices monitor cell voltage, pack temperature and current, record significant fault detection, and control cell balance.
system_benefits:
• Best BMS accuracy and long-term drift (LTD), with extended driving range and battery life performance and superior accuracy of 2mV and Six Sigma long-term drift.​
  • Low BOM cost and best FuSa/EMI/EMC/hot plug solution, which alleviates R&D effort and is easy to use with the RH850 automotive MCU family with dedicated drivers and software for BMS.​
  • Jump-start ASIL software development with the ISL78714 complex device driver (CDD), which manages BMS measurements and functional safety (FuSa) features.
  • Supports functional safety up to ASIL D as well as security features.​
  • Intelligent power device for external load control.

description: Renesas' automotive wireless battery management system (BMS) eliminates wire harnesses allowing for flexible battery placement, simplifying the development of scalable electric vehicles.
system_benefits:
• Eliminates the traditional wire harnesses required in a BMS, saving weight and space while improving flexibility
  • Easier battery replacement and reuse throughout the life cycle
  • Renesas’ low power Bluetooth® Low Energy (LE) 5.1 device*1 for wireless BMS is ideal for battery life cycle standardization based on the open Bluetooth LE standard, instead of a proprietary wireless protocol unique to a single supplier
  • Single-cell/Bluetooth LE with a Bluetooth LE MCU module for a flexible cell attachment/detachment concept
  • A system-level functional safety concept for the wireless BMS is under preparation

description: The shift toward electric 2- and 3-wheelers demands efficient, scalable motor control systems. This 48V inverter design supports 3kW motors and integrates with key vehicle components like brake sensors and accelerators, ensuring precise control and optimal performance. With scalable power stages and advanced fault detection using GreenPAK ICs, manufacturers can deliver reliable, energy-efficient solutions for diverse mobility needs.
system_benefits:
• The power stage can drive up to a 3kW motor.
  • Support is available to scale the 48V power stage of the inverter as per customer requirements.
  • GreenPAK ICs are used for low BOM count phase overcurrent fault detection.
  • The PMIC enhances safety and reliability, meeting ASIL-B standards for critical automotive applications.

model_name: Low Voltage Inverter for 2/3 Wheeler Traction Motor Control
description: The adoption of two- and three-wheeler electric vehicles for urban transportation is increasing in response to the market demand for efficient, reliable, and cost-effective electric vehicles (EVs). This low voltage inverter for 2/3 wheeler traction motor control features an MCU and analog products, designed for high-power 48V motor control applications. The design includes inverter hardware design files and peripheral sample code, allowing for fast evaluation and development based on real-life use cases.
system_benefits:
• Support is available to scale the 48V power stage of the inverter according to customer requirements, capable of driving up to a 10kW motor.
  • Supports connections with vehicle I/O, brake sensors, accelerator, gear, and drive modes, along with PWM output for the digital cluster.
  • Offers a comprehensive inverter evaluation for motor control applications using Renesas' automotive MCU.
  • Includes inverter hardware design files (schematics and Gerber) and peripheral sample code (for the motor control unit and resolver-to-digital converter), allowing for fast evaluation and development.

description: This system is a high-performance xEV traction motor and regeneration control solution using the RH850/C1M-Ax automotive microcontroller (MCU), supporting ASIL C and incorporating lock-step CPU cores and sophisticated motor control IP (EMU3).
system_benefits:
• Enhances diagnostic features and significantly reduces board area and BOM cost using an embedded resolver-to-digital (RDC) interface on the RH850/C1M-Ax MCU.
  • Provides a proven system-design approach through a power management IC (PMIC) specifically designed for the RH850/C series of automotive MCUs, optimizing BOM cost and board space.
  • Includes ready-to-start motor control software using the MCU EMU3 and embedded RDC.

description: The Renesas xEV inverter solution maximizes HEV/EV motor performance, the motor parameter calibration tool, and practical inverter hardware designs by using a combination of microcontrollers, power management ICs, gate driver ICs, insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), and fast recovery diodes (FRD).
system_benefits:
• Practical inverter specification for xEV 100kW class motor​
  • Jumpstarts evaluation with a reference solution kit, including inverter reference designs, software, model base designs, and calibration tools​
  • Provides early discovery and countermeasures for customers' issues, through Renesas' motor bench, dedicated engineering support​
  • 3.9L compact volume through highly integrated products and temperature management​
  • Superior power efficiency, with 99% maximum inverter efficiency
  • Function is already proven in real car demo​s
  • High-accuracy sensor error correction features

model_name: xEV Inverter with Inductive Position Sensor (IPS)
description: Combining an inductive position sensor (IPS) with an xEV inverter solution can reduce costs and the bill of materials (BOM) compared to using a resolver.
system_benefits:
• Over 30％*1 less expensive than resolvers. Contributes to the reduction of BOM components.
  • Verified noise immunity in high voltage inverter environments (400V, 100kW, 500Arms).
  • The inductive position sensor (IPS) enables a high accuracy angle of ≦0.1% full scale (with ideal coil), and high-speed rotation (up to 600,000rpm electrical revolutions). It is compact and light weight.
  • Easy to design and optimize your own IPS Tx/Rx coil pattern.
  • Sample software (RDC/ADC) is provided for quick evaluation.

description: This solution delivers an overall cockpit solution using the next-generation of haptic human machine interface (HMI).
system_benefits:
• Low-latency direct drive for haptics drives distinct haptic effects triggered by multiple inputs without having to wake the apps processor.
  • BroadLED™ backlight driver technology in the iW7039 LED driver provides best-in-class LED current matching with the highest possible efficiency.
  • A flexible system power management IC (PMIC) can supply a wide range of multicore system-on-chip ICs (SoCs) and integrates full power rail management with multiple sleep modes for an optimized system solution.
  • Reduces cost and development time using PMICs verified for R-Car SoCs.
  • Reference boards provide a quick and easy start to development.

model_name: Cost-Effective Automotive Haptic Touch Key Module for Enhanced Driver Safety
description: As vehicle interiors become more technologically advanced, there is a growing trend toward adopting capacitive touch buttons and interfaces. To ensure driver safety, these interfaces require haptic feedback, allowing drivers to confirm their actions without taking their eyes off the road. This cost-effective automotive touch key module integrates haptic feedback into any control switch, enhancing user experience and promoting vehicle safety.
system_benefits:
• An entry-level MCU manages touch sensing and haptic drivers while supporting high-speed CAN FD communication and EVITA-Light in-vehicle security for comprehensive system control at minimal cost.
  • Versatile haptic driver input triggers from GPIO pins allow different signal patterns to be assigned to multiple touch keys.
  • Features low idle current consumption (0.36µA) with minimized vibration delay (0.75ms).
  • A comprehensive demo board works with the touch sensitivity tuning tool, the low-power high-definition haptic driver evaluation kit, and a haptic sequence design tool with available software for the interoperation of both boards.

description: Automotive cockpits are vital for driver safety and experience, offering centralized controls and displays for key vehicle functions. With advancements in automotive technology, there is a growing demand for enhanced user experience, seamless connectivity, safety, and customization in vehicles.
system_benefits:
• Features the R-Car M3e-2G system-on-chip (SoC) with 2xCA57, 4xCA53, and 1xCR7 cores for high performance, efficiency, and versatility in real-time processing tasks.
  • Dual-OS setup with Android for infotainment and FreeRTOS for cluster applications optimizes resource utilization and enhances system stability and reliability.
  • A streamlined, hypervisor-less system simplifies design and reduces potential failure points.

model_name: Cost-Effective Digital Cluster with 4-channel AHL and Surround View
description: In automotive design, vehicle safety is a top priority. Clusters centralize critical driving information such as speed, fuel, navigation, and warnings to minimize driver distraction. Integrating safety features like the Surround View Monitor (SVM) enhances situational awareness.
system_benefits:
• No latency with excellent picture quality compared to digital transmission at a low cost.
  • Enables responsive automatic dimming control of the display in response to ambient brightness using a light sensor.
  • Reduces R&D cost and development time with power management ICs (PMICs) verified for R-Car M3, ensuring quicker time-to-market.
  • R-Car M3 and PMICs support functional safety up to ISO 26262 ASIL B.

description: This solution provides high efficiency while supporting a variety of display outputs. The high-quality outputs for scalable cockpit and infotainment solutions are made possible with the combination of a system-on-chip (SoC), power management IC (PMIC), and a configurable PCIe clock generator.
system_benefits:
• The system provides high efficiency and supports a variety of display outputs and high-quality outputs for scalable cockpit and infotainment solutions.
  • Enables smooth 3D clusters on the larger class 12.3-inch display at 1920 x 720 pixels.
  • A flexible power supply supports a wide range of multi-core SoCs and integrates full power rail management with multiple sleep modes for an optimized system solution.
  • Reduces R&D cost and development time using PMICs verified for R-Car SoCs.

description: This combination of the R-Car (H3/M3/M3N) system-on-chip (SoC), power management IC (PMIC), and programmable clock generator allows for a versatile solution. They enable scalable cockpit and infotainment solutions that support high image quality, multiple video display outputs, and a wide variety of memory interfaces all in one design.
system_benefits:
• A versatile system that enables scalable cockpit and infotainment solutions that support high image quality, multiple video display outputs, and a wide variety of memory interfaces.
  • Flexible clock generators can generate any clock frequency from 1MHz to 350MHz and allow a single device to replace several discrete clock circuits, saving BOM cost and reducing PCB area.
  • A flexible power supply can support a wide range of multicore SoCs and integrate full power rail management with multiple sleep modes for an optimized solution.
  • Reduces R&D cost and development time using PMICs verified for R-Car SoCs.

model_name: Infotainment & Automated Driving Systems with Fewer Components
description: Renesas offers a variety of infotainment and automated driving solutions using R-Car system-on-chip ICs (SoCs), which can be combined with CMICs*1to further reduce costs. CMIC GreenPAK™ is a cost-effective NVM*2programmable device that allows automotive designers to integrate many system functions into a single AEC-Q100 qualified IC.
system_benefits:
• Integrates many components in several Renesas R-Car systems into a tiny CMIC, allowing product differentiation at a lower cost and smaller PCB space.
  • The GreenPAK designer software/development kit enables quick modification to changing design requirements and increases productivity at the design and prototype verification stages.

description: Renesas offers a low-cost digital instrument cluster and HVAC display solution using a microcontroller (MCU) and video signal processor (VSP) scaler.
system_benefits:
• Simplified development of multiple display resolutions with a single design
  • Easily scalable cluster graphics for multiple display sizes and resolutions
  • Complete system solution design optimized for power consumption in an automotive environment
  • Generate cluster graphics in one resolution with the RH850 automotive MCU, then easily scale to different resolutions using the RAA278840 LCD controller
  • Use the RAA278840 to upscale 1280x480 resolution primary cluster graphics made for an 8” LCD panel to 1920x720 to support a 12.3” panel upgrade option for premium trim vehicle models
  • Use RAA278840 for "fast boot" to display tell-tale lamps at ignition (<500ms to show on-screen display (OSD) through RAA278840), allowing the MCU software time to boot up properly

model_name: Low-Cost TFT Instrument Cluster with Telematics
description: This reference design completely meets all customer requirements for an instrument cluster with telematics. It includes connectivity, tell-tale indicators, Wi-Fi mirroring of a mobile screen, Bluetooth®Low Energy (LE) connection, and brightness control of a TFT and camera image display.
system_benefits:
• Cost-effective, compact, and simple real-world vehicle instrument cluster to achieve graphics and connectivity. ​
  • Sample application software to jumpstart the application development. Sample firmware is Bare Metal C code and does not require any Linux/Android OS know-how to start development.​
  • Ready connectivity options available on the reference board - Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, Ethernet, GPS, and GSM-4G.​
  • Independent dual port CAN enables connection with other ECUs on the vehicle bus and also provides a separate interface for a diagnostic port.​
  • Eliminates expensive SerDes camera interface, replacing it with HD Link that interfaces to a low-cost analog camera via Single Twisted Pair [UTP/STP] connection without losing video quality.​
  • Support for cellphone-like UI using popular tools such as Qt, Candera, etc. is available.

description: Renesas' 12V small motor system provides an efficient BLDC motor controller, perfect for automotive pumps and fans. Utilizing a low-power automotive MCU, it supports Field Oriented Control (FOC) with 3-shunt and 1-shunt options and trapezoidal control. The highly integrated MCU ensures a compact, easily mountable design, reducing overall system size and simplifying installation within motor housings.
system_benefits:
• Speed up development with a complete reference design (circuit diagram, PCB design, characteristic data) and three types of sample control software (FOC 3-shunt/1-shunt, trapezoidal)
  • Cost-efficient with a compact board size (60mm x 56mm) for easy incorporation into motor housings

description: The Advanced Automotive Domain Controller (AADC) system integrates the Body Control Module (BCM), Smart Key Entry and Start System (SKESS), Telematics Gateway Unit (TGU), and Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) receiver. It achieves significant cost savings while maintaining seamless control over vehicle functions, transforming vehicles into smarter and more connected experiences.
system_benefits:
• Consolidates multiple functions into an efficient, high-performance unit with four powerful cores and 16MB flash, enabling real-time processing across various subsystems and reducing overall costs.
  • Provides a regulated 12V supply to various components and boosts in low VBAT. Paired with an ASIL-B PMIC, it ensures reliable operation even during cold cranking.
  • Integrates NFC, Bluetooth Low Energy, Wi-Fi, and LTE/GNSS, enabling seamless keyless entry, vehicle data transmission, firmware updates (FOTA), and diagnostics.
  • Supports up to 516 I/O pins and a wide range of communication protocols, including CAN FD, LIN, and 1Gb Ethernet, enabling smooth integration with multiple vehicle subsystems.
  • Features an on-chip EVITAL Full Hardware Security Module (HSM) to safeguard against unauthorized access using advanced cryptographic techniques.
  • Meets ASIL-D standards, delivering the highest level of functional safety for critical automotive applications.

description: As the global automotive industry shifts towards electrification, efficient thermal management of electric vehicle (EV) battery packs is crucial for optimal performance, longevity, and safety. Unlike traditional internal combustion engines that dissipate heat into the air, EV batteries require sophisticated cooling systems to maintain ideal operating temperatures.
system_benefits:
• The AEC-Q100 automotive-qualified MCU supports BLDC motor control with FOC algorithms, ensuring high performance and reliability for EV cooling systems.
  • The wide input buck regulator supports 12V/24V battery systems, making it versatile for various EV applications.
  • The 60V N-channel MOSFET and 55V/1A H-Bridge FET driver are suitable for car body applications.

model_name: Smart Bicycle Tail Light & Alarm System
description: This smart bicycle tail light and alarm system allows users to select different blinking patterns for various riding situations, such as stops, braking, and emergencies. Users can also trigger a horn as an alarm system and theft deterrent. A Bluetooth®Low Energy (LE) system-on-chip (SoC) serves as the central control unit, reading data from a connected accelerometer and controlling the LEDs and horn. To maximize the horn's sound pressure, it is driven by an H-bridge equipped, I2C-controlled high-voltage GreenPAK™ (HVPAK™) programmable mixed-signal matrix, powered by the reverse boost voltage of the charger PMIC. Additionally, different LED configurations can be selected, utilizing the Bluetooth LE SoC's integrated ADC and the PMIC's adjustable boost output voltage in combination with the HVPAK's second H-bridge to control, for example, two different LED colors without additional discrete switches.
system_benefits:
• The ultra-compact design includes a Bluetooth LE SoC, switching charger with reverse boost, and I2C-controlled dual H-bridge power control and driver device.
  • Allows customization of LED light settings, including brightness, color, and blink patterns, to adapt to different riding situations such as stops, braking, and emergencies.
  • Utilizes a full-bridge driver to maximize the horn's sound pressure, enhancing its effectiveness as an alarm and theft deterrent.
  • Features an automatic alarm system that uses the Bluetooth LE received signal strength indicator (RSSI) to detect unauthorized movement, enhancing security.

model_name: Solid State Automotive Power Distribution Module
description: Renesas provides an efficient power distribution network solution based on Intelligent Power Device (IPD) technologies. The intelligent protection and diagnostic functions of the IPDs raise the safety level over mechanical relays. Together with their small size and weight, IPDs are the key enabler to building advanced automotive power distribution networks with cable harness optimization and functional safety implementation. The battery power is split into multiple parallel lines providing a protected and distributed power supply into the network. This forms the basis of creating any type of hierarchical architecture, enabling further nesting to achieve the desired safety level through redundancy.
system_benefits:
• Relay and fuse replacement by high operating current IPDs with protection features to shut down the circuit during over-temperature and overcurrent situations.
  • Optimize BOM and realize miniaturization with the RL78 MCU line-up containing small packages and low power consumption.
  • An MCU monitors the load current of IPDs through programmable control current sense terminal check and shut down in the suitable sequence once overcurrent is detected.
  • Soft start-up by cascaded switch-on of the IPDs is possible to control the timing of each peak current.
  • Achieve functional safety through parallel power lines supporting redundant networks.

model_name: Solid State Automotive Power Distribution Module with eFuse
description: Renesas provides an efficient power distribution network solution based on Intelligent Power Device (IPD) technologies. The intelligent protection and diagnostic functions of the IPDs increase the safety level over mechanical relays. This solution optimizes wiring harnesses and improves reliability by adding current monitoring capabilities.
system_benefits:
• Reduce the size and weight of a fuse box by integrating 10 output channels on a compact-sized board, aligning with the smart eFuse (electronic fuse) concept.
  • eFuses offer maintenance-free load and wire protection that can be configured and adapted to a variety of cables. Significant higher accuracy of the eFuses reduces the weight of the wire harness.
  • The software-based eFuse is activated from the current-sense feedback of the IPD to the MCU. The MCU is programmed to implement the fuse function.
  • A safe parking mode*1 can be emulated by switching on the IPD and setting the MCU into a low-power mode.

description: A sunroof control system combines an MCU and intelligent power device (IPD) to deliver precise, efficient, and reliable operation. The MCU serves as the system's core, interpreting user inputs such as switches or touch commands and managing functions like tilt, slide, and full open/close positions. This system integrates seamlessly with the vehicle's body control network using CAN or LIN communication protocols. It is designed to prioritize safety, optimize energy usage, and ensure a compact, durable architecture for modern automotive applications.
system_benefits:
• The MCU features low current consumption, ideal for automotive applications.
  • The IPD drives the sunroof motor with high efficiency, combining power handling with integrated protection features.
  • Benefits include enhanced safety, energy efficiency, compact design, and durability.
  • The combination of the MCU and IPD ensures precise motor control, robust protection, and an improved user experience, meeting modern automotive standards for comfort and reliability.

description: The vehicle control unit (VCU) device facilitates the implementation of a service-oriented architecture (SOA) or software-defined vehicle (SDV). It supports zonal architecture by OEMs and can function as a central computer/gateway in entry-level and commercial vehicles. The automotive-control MCU provides sufficient performance headroom with a multi-core architecture compliant with functional safety (FuSa) standards from ASIL-B to ASIL-D.
system_benefits:
• Hardware design files and sample software are available, facilitating rapid prototyping and development of custom designs.
  • The MCU supports the No-Wait Over-the-Air (OTA) updates, allowing seamless software upgrades and maintenance without vehicle downtime.
  • The onboard embedded Multi-Media Card (eMMC) provides large storage for various use cases and supports the increasing data requirements of modern vehicles.

model_name: Vehicle Window Control with Anti-Pinch Safety
description: This vehicle window control design integrates an MCU, buttons, DC motor, power supply, and power devices to offer comprehensive window control. It features motor forward and reverse control, window anti-pinch, and more, providing a sensitive response, fast speed, and easy operation. The system meets the automotive industry's demand for sophisticated, safety-compliant window control systems, aligning with global trends for enhanced vehicle safety and user comfort.
system_benefits:
• Simple and effective control of the window motor ensures smooth and precise operation.
  • The current ripple algorithm supports the anti-pinch function, significantly improving passenger safety and meeting modern automotive safety standards.
  • CAN and LIN modules for automotive interfaces are integrated into the MCU, facilitating seamless integration with vehicle communication networks and reducing overall system complexity.
  • Automotive-grade high voltage, high frequency, half-bridge driver, and high current switching MOSFET.

description: The Zone-ECU virtualization platform is a development tool that integrates multiple virtual electronic control units (ECUs) on a single physical ECU. This comprehensive platform combines Renesas' high-performance MCUs with ETAS' RTA-HVR hypervisor software, providing a pre-integrated environment for the rapid development of next-generation zonal E/E architectures. It supports the automotive industry's shift towards centralized E/E architectures, aiding in the creation of software-defined vehicles (SDVs) while reducing system complexity and cost.
system_benefits:
• Significantly reduces development effort with a pre-built design, lowering costs and development risks.
  • Combines the MCU hardware key features like hypervisor support, safety, security, and quality of service (QoS) with ETAS' outstanding software product portfolio and software competence, based on the collaboration between ETAS and Renesas.
  • Enables integration of multiple applications into a single ECU, ensuring they are safely and securely separated to maintain the highest degree of freedom from interference.
  • Provides a "ready-to-run" configuration showcasing various virtual machine (VM) setups (single-core, multi-core, and multi-VM per core) via a PC-hosted application.

description: This solution provides a complete reference design with hardware and software for automotive gateway applications to support the electrical/electronic (E/E) architecture. It provides an integrated system that controls an ever-increasing number of vehicle functions in all areas of vehicle control.
system_benefits:
• Reduces the board size and BOM costs through MCU core integration into the system-on-chip (SoC) and uses a single board to control both the MCU domain and application SoC domain, which previously required separate devices.​
  • The reference board consists of a CPU board with a core SoC, power management IC (PMIC) and memory, and an interface board, enabling support for a variety of networks.
    • Supports 16 channels of CAN FD (can be used as 16 channels of local interconnect network (LIN) and 8 channels of single edge nibble transmission (SENT) by multi-function), 2 channels of FlexRay, 2 channels of PCIe v4.0 x2 lanes, and 3 channels of 5G-USXGMII for Ethernet.​
  • The core system is realized by installing the R-Car S4 automotive SoC, LPDDR4x-3200 memory, and HyperFlash™ memory on the CPU board.
  • Flexible clock generator capable of generating 12 outputs, PCIe Gen 1-4 clocks for automotive applications, and Universal Flash Storage (UFS) clocks to support multiple channels in a single device.

description: Renesas offers monitoring functions using a tiny CMIC*1in a variety of motor control applications. CMIC GreenPAK™ is a cost-effective NVM*2programmable device that allows automotive designers to integrate many system functions into a single AEC-Q100 qualified IC, resulting in minimizing component count and board space.
system_benefits:
• Provides an overcurrent detection system using a shunt resistor for 12V motor systems and a current sensor for xEV motor systems.
  • Provides motor rotation position detection through a zero-cross comparator in a square-wave motor controller system.
  • Enables retrofitting the CMIC to existing designs.
  • The GreenPAK designer software/development kit enables quick modification to changing design requirements and increases productivity at the design and prototype verification stages.

description: This Renesas sensor solution is used for many car applications which monitor pressure (HVAC, oil) and position sensing (liquid levels), etc. The solution provides a flexible and high-accuracy sensor system with sensor signal conditioners (SSC), DC/DC, MCU, and LIN IF.
system_benefits:
• Easier integration of SSC in the car network with CAN and LIN interfaces
  • MCU extends SSC functionality and off-loads processing from the main ECU
  • Reduces the customer's R&D costs with Renesas' software support
  • Flexible communications interface to the vehicle network

description: As a wireless gateway, the telematics box provides remote communication interfaces for the entire vehicle through 4G remote wireless communication, GPS satellite positioning, acceleration sensing, CAN communication, and other functions, and provides services such as driving data acquisition, driving track recording, vehicle fault monitoring, vehicle remote query and control (unlocking, air conditioning control, window control, transmitter torque limit, engine start and stop), driving behavior analysis, 4G wireless hotspot sharing, etc.
system_benefits:
• Automotive-grade MCU with CAN interface
  • Gateway provides vehicle/charging data
  • Winning combo support via Renesas MCU, power and analog devices

model_name: Communication Gateway & Integrated DVR/DMS System Solution
description: E/E architectures in the automotive CASE era are evolving and there is widespread use of Communication Gateways (CoGWs), in addition to the traditional key components of ADAS, IVI, and in-vehicle control. This solution provides a reference environment integrating a Driving Video Recorder (DVR)/Driver Monitoring System (DMS) for video processing applications into the central CoGW system by using the high-performance R-Car S4 for CoGW and R-Car M3/RH850.
system_benefits:
• A proven reference environment for evaluation of SoCs and MCU in a CoGW application
  • Reduces concept study time, and allows users to leap forward to the feasibility study and system rationalization using the different reference boards
  • Enables evaluation under high data rate conditions, communicating video data input/output via Gigabit Ethernet/PCIe
  • Provides foundational CoGW function and R-Car S4 allows extended functionality to DVR/DMS applications

model_name: Connected Gateway for Future E/E Architecture
description: Renesas assists developers at OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to define E/E architectures for the next-generation vehicles (e.g. connected car). The R-Car family delivers a high computing power system-on-chip (SoC) combined with the RH850/U2A MCU equipped with state-of-the-art real-time and 16MB flash memory, providing sufficient processing power to support various and a huge number of communication channels.
system_benefits:
• Supports a variety of physical network interfaces, including Gbit Ethernet, high-speed serial interface, 16ch CAN FD, 24ch LIN/UART, FlexRay, SENT, MOST, etc.
  • Scalable performance R-Car Gen3 SoC to manage high-level application software based on Linux, Adaptive AUTOSAR and Classic AUTOSAR.
  • High-performance, multi-connectivity microcontroller manages real-time related tasks and communication to other ECUs (gateway controller).
  • Highly integrated power management ICs ensure ISO 26262 compliant power supplies and are optimized for the SoC to reduce bill-of-material (BOM) costs while providing industry-leading efficiency.

model_name: Instrument Panel for Light Electric Vehicles
description: This instrument panel for light electric vehicles (LEV) utilizes a highly integrated system-on-chip (SoC) that consists of a power management unit (PMU), a graphical processor (GPU), a Bluetooth®Low Energy (LE) radio, and an independent sensor block. With this setup, the panel seamlessly connects and supports a wide range of sensors.
system_benefits:
• Highly integrated Bluetooth LE device
  • Power management unit with charger
  • Arm® Cortex®-M33
  • Sensor node controller (SNC)
  • I3C
  • 2D GPU
  • Optimize architecture for small form factor design
  • Voice activity detection and keyword detection for audio assistance
  • CAN bus support
  • USB charging support

description: Renesas' tire pressure monitoring system monitors real-time air pressure and temperature, alerting drivers of improperly-inflated tires or other safety information immediately.
system_benefits:
• SmartBond TINY™, the world’s smallest and lowest power Bluetooth® Low Energy (LE) 5.1 system-on-chip (SoC), brings down the cost of adding Bluetooth Low Energy in automotive systems.
  • Addresses BOM cost reduction through a PCB pattern antenna and a highly integrated low power Bluetooth LE SoC.
  • No dedicated receiver is necessary in the vehicle infotainment system.
  • A flexible system power management IC (PMIC) can supply a wide range of multicore SoCs and integrates full power rail management with multiple sleep modes for an optimized system solution.
  • Reduces cost and development time using PMICs verified for R-Car SoCs.
  • Reference boards provide a quick and easy start to development.

model_name: Vehicle Computer for Future E/E Architecture
description: The vehicle computer solution is an ideal platform for the development of applications such as gateways, car servers, and zone control. It enables the realization and support of next-generation E/E architecture.
system_benefits:
• Supports the newest automotive network technologies (TSN Ethernet switch, 10BASE-T1S, 1000BASE-RH, 2.5GBASE-T1, etc.) plus legacy networks (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, and SENTetc.) In addition, support for analog input, wake-up, and real-time clocks increases development usability.​
  • Sufficient computing power (up to 27K DMIPS application performance plus greater than 5.3K DMIPS real-time performance) to host the ever-increasing amount of user applications.​
  • Allows designers to re-use up to 80% of the software code developed for three generations of R-Car system-on-chip (SoC) and RH850 automotive MCU applications.​
  • The combination of pre-regulators and PMICs developed for R-Car S4 can provide various supply voltages to meet functional safety requirements up to ASIL D in accordance with ISO 26262.

model_name: Wireless Telematic Unit for Vehicle Connectivity
description: As the automotive industry rapidly evolves towards connected and intelligent transportation systems, the demand for advanced telematics solutions is growing. This system integrates multiple wireless technologies to enable enhanced connectivity in modern vehicles. It incorporates Bluetooth®Low Energy (LE), Wi-Fi, and LTE modules, along with GPS and Near Field Communication (NFC) capabilities. This telematics unit upgrades existing electronic control units (ECUs) for cloud connectivity. NFC technology integration allows for innovative applications, such as linking NFC-enabled smartphones with vehicle infotainment systems, enhancing user experience and connectivity options.
system_benefits:
• Transforms automotive clusters into connected clusters, facilitating software-defined vehicle (SDV) implementation and supporting over-the-air (OTA) ECU upgrades.
  • Enables in-vehicle payments using an NFC card and access to vehicle data with a single tap.
  • Onboard level shifters provide flexibility to interface with various voltage levels.
  • Selectable supply source (onboard/external interfacing system).
  • Features Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi modules with the industry's lowest power consumption, optimizing energy efficiency.
  • Board-to-board connections are applicable in systems like a TFT instrument cluster with telematics board and vehicle control unit.

description: Electric mobility platforms are rapidly expanding across diverse applications, including e-bikes, e-scooters, forklifts, and hybrid electric vehicles. Renesas offers a versatile 48V mobility platform that provides engineers with a customizable design to target specific requirements, such as low voltage and cost, enhanced functionality and efficiency, or high power and torque. This adaptable design delivers the essential building blocks for developing various motor solutions, ensuring optimal performance and flexibility for a wide range of electric mobility applications.
system_benefits:
• Complete design options for low voltage and cost, enhanced functionality and efficiency, or high power and torque solutions.
  • Versatile compatibility with various electric motor drive solutions and voltage ranges.

model_name: Remote Sensing with Inductive Position Sensor & CAN/LIN
description: This remote sensing system supports robust next-generation vehicle electrical/electronic (E/E) architectures by enhancing the protection of Electronic Control Unit (ECU) communication networks. It facilitates the transition from numerous individual control units to a more centralized system with fewer, but more powerful vehicle computers.
system_benefits:
• Long-distance remote sensing over CAN/LIN.
  • Includes basic drivers for the MCU, facilitating easy integration and development.
  • Enhanced data security, support for over-the-air (OTA) updates, and full bi-directional communication, allowing sensor reconfiguration over its lifetime.
  • Mitigates noise and parasitic components over longer distances in new car E/E architectures with centralized ECUs.
  • Reduces wiring by supporting multiple sensors multiplexed on one interface.
  • Suitable for automotive body control modules, vehicle controller units, and related applications.
  • Suitable for bridge ECU and inductive position sensor (IPS) for applications like console and throttle pedal.
